thread:
sara_infra: @here heads-up: we need a tactical sync for the Dedicated fleet kernel+driver wave next Wed. Proposal: 3 waves with a small canary pool + a hot reserve of spare capacity. I put a draft scheduler below. Need ops + SRE signoff.

miguel_ops: +1. can we avoid updating kernels during peak billing windows? next Wed has a big customer run in ap-southeast.

anya_eng: noted. recommend MTU/fragmentation smoke tests pre-wave. last time we saw NCCL stalls tied to MTU mismatch.

ryan_sre: agree on smoke tests. also request a forced-evac window to verify autoscaler behaves when we drain nodes. don't want stuck allocations.

janet_product: what's the rollback policy? customers on Dedicated care about capacity guarantees. need clear SLA-friendly plan.

{sara_infra}: Rollback: immediate fallback to pinned driver+kernel image v495.2 + routing to reserved pool. Plan:
```
wave-scheduler --wave 1 --pct 5 --region eu-west1 --canary-tag canary-wave-1
wave-scheduler --wave 2 --pct 20 --region eu-west1,us-west1
wave-scheduler --wave 3 --pct 75 --region global
reserve-pool create --size 25% --target dedicated-pool-1
```
Smoke checks after each wave: quick LL/UL perf, KV-cache sanity, and NCCL allreduce demo. If any smoke test fails, controller aborts remaining waves and triggers rollback route.

miguel_ops: how do we define 'smoke test fail'? CPU/GPU stalls >10s on 5% of canaries? NCCL errors > 0.5%?

anya_eng: propose thresholds: >3% p50 latency regression OR any NCCL fatal error OR kernel oops on >1 node -> fail. Keep thresholds tight for canaries, looser later.

ryan_sre: add health-check for kmsg kernel oops filter and dmesg grep in the smoke pipeline. If any kmsg contains 'kernel panic' or 'oops', immediate fatal. Also include MTU verify: `ip link show` + validate 1500/9000 as configured.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-upgrade. Steps will auto-insert into incident if rollback triggered.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: id=roll-2026-03-25-01, canary endpoints tagged: dedicated-canary-2026-03-25. Window: 02:00-06:00 UTC.

janet_product: Customer comms? We'll send an advisory to Dedicated customers 48h prior, mention potential brief degraded throughput and fallback plan.

{sara_infra}: Cost note: reserve pool (25%) increases short-term cost. We can reduce to 15% if we accept slower drain/restore time. Any objections?

miguel_ops: prefer 25% for the first run. last incident costed more in page time.

anya_eng: FYI: quantized kernels for the new driver show ~3% perf variance on seq len 2048 tests; include that in perf smoke.

ryan_sre: I'll own the rollback exec and monitoring dashboard. I'll add token-level traces for canaries so we can attribute regressions quickly.

{sara_infra}: final asks before I stamp this: SRE own rollback playbook, Ops create reserve pool, Eng add MTU + NCCL smoke jobs to CI, Product prepare customer advisory. If all clear by EOD tomorrow we'll lock windows. :thumbsup:

miguel_ops: I'll create the reserve pool and post link.

ops-runbook-bot: Reserve pool task created: RP-7621.

{sara_infra}: thanks everyone. I'll update the rollout doc and post an invite for a 15m sync tomorrow.
